title: WARRANT gate
description: Gate — a transition rule that aggregates evidence into a `gate_verdict` (06 section 3).

id.description: Gate id, unique across the packs enabled in a project.

overrides.description: Pack object this local gate replaces, as `<pack>:<id>` (08 section 4).

description.description: What this gate asserts, in one sentence.

level.description: Verification level of the evidence this gate aggregates.

applies_when.description: Conditions under which the gate is evaluated; otherwise the verdict is NOT_APPLICABLE.

changed_paths.description: Glob patterns over changed paths that activate this gate.

items.description: Glob pattern relative to the project root.

requires_evidence.description: Evidence that MUST be present with the given status for the gate to pass.

kind.description: Evidence kind from the catalogue declared by packs.

check.description: Id of the check whose records alone satisfy this requirement; records of other producers of the kind are ignored (ADR-0044 section 6).

waivable.description: Whether an ACTIVE waiver may replace a failing verdict. No default is implied (INV-10).

accepts_attestation.description: Attestation types accepted for the evidence of this gate.
